content: HN Algolia API hn.algolia.com/api/v1: tags=front_page returns current front page (live-verified nbHits=145); tags include story, ask_hn, show_hn, front_page, author_X; numericFilters=points>N,num_comments>N,created_at_i>ts; search_by_date for recency (rising = recent + points threshold); hitsPerPage up to ~1000, 10k req/hr keyless. Firebase topstories/beststories need N+1 fetches — prefer Algolia.
